title: Lobster in Cosmic Bubble
description: A large glowing orange lobster floats inside a translucent teardrop-shaped bubble filled with green leaves and sparkling lights, illuminated by a bright bulb it holds. Below, a group of people in colorful patterned robes stand with arms raised in a ritualistic circle around a woman seated at the base of a giant red-spotted mushroom who holds up a small glowing orb, all set within an elaborate stained-glass window frame.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene framed as a tall arched stained-glass window with intricate patterns. Inside a large glowing teardrop bubble floats a bright orange lobster holding a lit lightbulb, surrounded by green leaves and sparkles. Below the bubble, a group of dark-skinned people in colorful geometric robes stand in a circle with arms raised in celebration. In the foreground, a woman sits at the base of a giant Amanita muscaria mushroom holding up a glowing orb. Magical energy flows between the elements, with small fairies flying around. Rich jewel tones, mystical atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
